app.subtitle: Sungai Komering · OKU Timur · South Sumatra
dosir.lead_river: Flows at the weir are long-term figures from the old Martapura gauge and later studies; no flow record at the weir is public.
dosir.lead_upstream: Danau Ranau feeds the river in the dry season through a regulating weir; a large storage dam is being built on a tributary.
irigasi.crops3: Two rice crops and a dry-season palawija crop a year.
irigasi.tiga: Add a dry-season release from the Tiga Dihaji reservoir (under construction, not yet filled)
irigasi.tiga_note: Under construction, not yet filled{status}. {used} of its {store} million m³ of effective storage would be released over the short half-months; it covers {pct} of the gap.
ringkas.intro_1: Perjaya Weir holds back Sungai Komering near Martapura and turns part of it into the canal that waters the rice fields of OKU Timur.
